name: Pinball Table
notes: Sample project: a pinball table built in 665 steps across 16 numbered bags. Placements were authored by hand and are approximate.

steps.title: Start with the center
steps.description: Place the gray 2 × 2 brick in the middle of the red 2 × 12 plate. Leave five columns of studs exposed on either side.

steps.title: Build out the frame
steps.description: Add a black 2 × 4 brick on each side of the gray brick. Fit the two Technic corners over the end columns, with their free arms pointing outward.

steps.title: Lock the center together
steps.description: Add the second red 2 × 12 plate across the top. Align it directly above the first plate to join the center bricks and both corners.

steps.title: Reinforce both corners
steps.description: Attach a red curved plate to the top and underside of each corner. All four plates keep their studs pointing up; the lower plates connect into the underside of the black bricks.

steps.title: Finish the upper surfaces
steps.description: Place a black 1 × 4 tile across each end, from the long red plate onto the curved plate. Center the 2 × 2 modified plate above the gray brick, with its two studs along the back edge.

steps.title: Insert the two connector pins
steps.description: Push a black friction pin into the innermost front-facing hole on each outward arm. Leave the outer half of each pin exposed to hold the crossbeam.

steps.title: Connect the front crossbeam
steps.description: Slide the black 15-hole beam onto the two pins. The first and last holes align with the pins, connecting the outward arms across the front.

steps.title: Cap the outward arms
steps.description: Attach a red 1 × 4 plate to the two exposed studs at the end of each black arm. The other two studs overhang outward. The plates sit beside the curved plates, at the same height.

steps.title: Start a separate mechanism
steps.description: Set the frame aside. Overlap two white 2 × 3 plates by one column of studs, leaving a three-stud row exposed on the left of the lower plate.

steps.title: Add the wedge plate
steps.description: Attach the dark gray wedge to the three exposed studs on the lower white plate. Its sloping edge projects outward, with the wide end at the back.

steps.title: Stack the rear rail
steps.description: Stack two dark gray 1 × 4 plates and a red 1 × 4 plate. Attach the stack across the back row, with one stud extending past the left side.

steps.title: Add the raised bracket
steps.description: Attach the black stepped bracket to the white base, with its low two-stud ledge facing forward. Place the lime flower plate on the exposed front stud of the wedge.

steps.title: Build the front hinge rail
steps.description: Place the light gray 1 × 4 hinge plate on the left four studs of a 1 × 5 plate, then the tall side-stud brick on its remaining right stud. Attach this rail across the front, with the hinge fingers facing outward and the tall brick at the right end.

steps.title: Build the axle mechanism
steps.description: Thread the 4L black axle through the two axle-hole bricks and two flexible double joiners. Insert the red 2L axle through the forward holes. Add a lime flower plate to each brick, then seat the assembly on the front hinge rail.

motion.source: Page 13, step 14, detail panels 1–5, then the mounting arrow

steps.title: Cover the mechanism
steps.description: Add the rounded 1 × 2 plate to the low ledge of a second stepped bracket, and the door-rail plate underneath its raised front edge. Seat the bracket on the rear support so its raised deck covers the axle mechanism.

motion.source: Page 13, step 15, detail panels 1–2, then the mounting arrow

steps.title: Bring the assemblies together
steps.description: Fit the completed mechanism beneath the arm. Its gray rounded plate connects under the red cap while its red rear rail connects under the black arm.

steps.title: Start the opposite mechanism
steps.description: Set the completed frame aside. Overlap two white 2 × 3 plates by one stud column, leaving the opposite edge of the lower plate exposed.

steps.title: Add the opposite wedge
steps.description: Fit the dark gray left wedge to the three exposed studs. Its wide end faces the rear rail, mirroring the first mechanism.

steps.title: Stack the opposite rear rail
steps.description: Stack two dark gray 1 × 4 plates and a red 1 × 4 plate, then mount the completed stack across the back row.

motion.source: Page 14, step 19, stacking inset, then the mounting arrow

steps.title: Raise the opposite bracket
steps.description: Attach the black stepped bracket to the white base with its low ledge facing forward. Add the lime flower plate to the exposed front stud of the wedge.

steps.title: Build the opposite hinge rail
steps.description: Fit the hinge plate onto four studs of the 1 × 5 plate. Add the tall side-stud brick at the free end, with its side studs facing outward, then mount the completed rail across the front.

motion.source: Page 14, step 21, numbered detail panels 1–2, then the mounting arrow

steps.title: Complete the opposite axle mechanism
steps.description: Thread the 4L black axle through the two axle-hole bricks and two flexible double joiners. Insert the red 2L axle through the forward holes. Add a lime flower plate to each brick, then seat the assembly on the front hinge rail.

motion.source: Page 15, step 22, detail panels 1–5, then the mounting arrow

steps.title: Cover the opposite mechanism
steps.description: Add the rounded 1 × 2 plate to the low ledge of a second stepped bracket, and the door-rail plate underneath its raised front edge. Seat the bracket on the rear support so its raised deck covers the axle mechanism.

motion.source: Page 15, step 23, detail panels 1–2, then the mounting arrow

steps.title: Mount the opposite mechanism
steps.description: Fit the completed opposite-hand mechanism beneath the other red arm extension. Its gray rounded plate connects under the red cap, while its rear rail connects under the black arm, mirroring step 16.

steps.title: Add the upper wing plates
steps.description: Add a black triangular plate above each inner flower stud, a dark gray rounded plate across each outer pair of studs, and a blue rounded plate on the exposed outer studs of each red arm cap.

motion.source: Page 16, step 25, six highlighted additions

steps.title: Reinforce the underside
steps.description: Turn the frame over. Build two supports, each with a gray 1 × 3 brick between tan plates, and fit them under the frame ends. Attach the two stepped side-stud plates beneath the overlapping white bases, with their side studs facing outward.

motion.source: Page 16, step 26: turn-over symbol, repeated 1 × 3 sandwich inset, and underside arrows

steps.title: Finish the curved inner caps
steps.description: Turn the frame upright again. Fit a dark gray curved 2 × 1 slope toward the center of each triangular plate, then add the chamfered 1 × 2 tile beside it. Leave the triangle’s outer row of three studs exposed.

motion.source: Page 17, step 27: turn-over symbol and highlighted caps

steps.title: Start the first side rail
steps.description: Fit the white 2 × 4 plate over the end four columns of the black 2 × 10 plate.

steps.title: Add the end brackets
steps.description: Fit the rounded plate on the inner back pair and the two white brackets across the end pairs, with their flat flanges facing outward.

steps.title: Build the first handle recess
steps.description: Cap the two brackets with a black 2 × 2 plate. Set the green handle on the rounded support with its bar over the exposed white row.

steps.title: Extend the green and gray walls
steps.description: Place the two 1 × 8 bricks beside the handle recess, overhanging the base by two studs.

steps.title: Bridge the first recess
steps.description: Run the white 1 × 8 plate along the back row, add the rounded front plates and cap the wall with a white square tile. Leave the end stud pair exposed.

steps.title: Lengthen the rail base
steps.description: Slide a black 2 × 12 plate under the two overhanging brick columns; ten columns remain exposed.

steps.title: Build and mount the second handle recess
steps.description: Build the white base, two corner plates, green handle and rounded end plates in the numbered inset order, then fit the group beside the wall.

motion.source: Page 20, step 34, numbered panels 1–3 and mounting arrow

steps.title: Extend the middle wall
steps.description: Place the tan log brick across the rail beside the recess, followed by parallel green and gray 1 × 8 bricks.

steps.title: Tie the middle wall together
steps.description: Bridge the recess with the back plate and two front 1 × 3 plates. Add the 2 × 4 plate alongside them, leaving three end columns exposed.

steps.title: Extend the base again
steps.description: Attach the next black 2 × 12 plate beneath the three overhanging wall columns.

steps.title: Build the yellow handle recess
steps.description: Assemble the white base and corner plates, then the yellow handle and rounded end plates. Mount the completed group beside the green wall.

motion.source: Page 22, step 38, numbered panels 1–3 and mounting arrow

steps.title: Add the black wall block
steps.description: Fit the black 2 × 3 brick beside the yellow recess, leaving two base columns exposed.

steps.title: Bridge the yellow recess
steps.description: Connect the green wall and black block with white top plates, keeping the yellow handle accessible from the side.

steps.title: Build the final yellow handle recess
steps.description: Build the five-piece inset, then mount it over the last two base columns, with two columns extending beyond the base.

motion.source: Page 23, step 41, numbered panels 1–3 and mounting arrow

steps.title: Support the end recess
steps.description: Fit a black 2 × 3 plate beneath the overhang, leaving one column beyond the yellow handle.

steps.title: Add the round end support
steps.description: Fit the gray round brick on the end column. Insert the lower row of the red stepped plate beneath its overhanging row; the raised row extends beyond the round brick.

steps.title: Finish the end connector
steps.description: Place the red side-stud brick on the raised red row. Complete the white back strip and front plates, level with the red brick top.

steps.title: Add the black mounting strip
steps.description: Fit the 4 × 6 end plate, three 2 × 8 plates and the 2 × 3 end plate along the back row. The strip overhangs the back of the wall by one stud.

steps.title: Tile the long blue edge
steps.description: Add five blue 1 × 6 tiles along the outer row and a blue 2 × 4 tile on the end pad. Keep the adjacent black stud row exposed.

steps.title: Fit the blue end connector
steps.description: Press the blue stepped plate sideways onto both rows of red side studs.

steps.title: Mount the first side rail
steps.description: Turn the rail onto its side. Fit the underside of its black end-base plate over the two outward-facing studs of the frame’s stepped plate.

steps.title: Lock the first rail to the frame
steps.description: Bridge the frame’s blue rounded plate and the lower row of the rail’s blue end connector with a tan 2 × 2 plate.

steps.title: Start the opposite side rail
steps.description: Fit the white 2 × 4 plate over the end four columns of the black 2 × 10 plate.

steps.title: Add the end brackets
steps.description: Fit the rounded plate on the inner back pair and the two white brackets across the end pairs, with their flat flanges facing outward.

steps.title: Build the opposite handle recess
steps.description: Cap the two brackets with a black 2 × 2 plate. Set the green handle on the rounded support with its bar over the exposed white row.

steps.title: Extend the green and gray walls
steps.description: Place the two 1 × 8 bricks beside the handle recess, overhanging the base by two studs.

steps.title: Bridge the opposite recess
steps.description: Run the white 1 × 8 plate along the back row, add the rounded front plates and cap the wall with a white square tile. Leave the end stud pair exposed.

steps.title: Lengthen the rail base
steps.description: Slide a black 2 × 12 plate under the two overhanging brick columns; ten columns remain exposed.

steps.title: Build and mount the second handle recess
steps.description: Build the white base, two corner plates, green handle and rounded end plates in the numbered inset order, then fit the group beside the wall.

motion.source: Page 30, step 56, mirrored numbered inset and mounting arrow

steps.title: Extend the middle wall
steps.description: Place the tan log brick across the rail beside the recess, followed by parallel green and gray 1 × 8 bricks.

steps.title: Tie the middle wall together
steps.description: Bridge the recess with the back plate and two front 1 × 3 plates. Add the 2 × 4 plate alongside them, leaving three end columns exposed.

steps.title: Extend the base again
steps.description: Attach the next black 2 × 12 plate beneath the three overhanging wall columns.

steps.title: Build the yellow handle recess
steps.description: Assemble the white base and corner plates, then the yellow handle and rounded end plates. Mount the completed group beside the green wall.

motion.source: Page 32, step 60, mirrored numbered inset and mounting arrow

steps.title: Add the black wall block
steps.description: Fit the black 2 × 3 brick beside the yellow recess, leaving two base columns exposed.

steps.title: Bridge the yellow recess
steps.description: Connect the green wall and black block with white top plates, keeping the yellow handle accessible from the side.

steps.title: Build the final yellow handle recess
steps.description: Build the five-piece inset, then mount it over the last two base columns, with two columns extending beyond the base.

motion.source: Page 34, step 63, mirrored numbered inset and mounting arrow

steps.title: Support the end recess
steps.description: Fit a black 2 × 3 plate beneath the overhang, leaving one column beyond the yellow handle.

steps.title: Add the round end support
steps.description: Fit the gray round brick on the end column. Insert the lower row of the red stepped plate beneath its overhanging row; the raised row extends beyond the round brick.

steps.title: Finish the end connector
steps.description: Place the red side-stud brick on the raised red row. Complete the white back strip and front plates, level with the red brick top.

steps.title: Add the black mounting strip
steps.description: Fit the 4 × 6 end plate, three 2 × 8 plates and the 2 × 3 end plate along the back row. The strip overhangs the back of the wall by one stud.

steps.title: Tile the long blue edge
steps.description: Add five blue 1 × 6 tiles along the outer row and a blue 2 × 4 tile on the end pad. Keep the adjacent black stud row exposed.

steps.title: Fit the blue end connector
steps.description: Press the blue stepped plate sideways onto both rows of red side studs.

steps.title: Mount the opposite side rail
steps.description: Turn the completed rail onto its side and fit the black end-base plate onto the frame’s other pair of outward-facing studs.

steps.title: Lock and reinforce both rails
steps.description: Add the second tan joining plate. Fit a black 2 × 3 plate under each rail across the first base seam, leaving the last green-wall column beyond the reinforcement.

steps.title: Start the rear crossbar
steps.description: Center the white 2 × 4 tile on the green 1 × 8 brick, leaving two studs exposed at each end. The tile overhangs the front row.

steps.title: Support the tile’s front edge
steps.description: Fit the gray 1 × 8 brick beside the green brick, underneath the overhanging half of the tile.

steps.title: Extend both ends of the base
steps.description: Attach two black 2 × 12 plates underneath the central bricks, meeting at the center seam.

steps.title: Build the outer blocks
steps.description: Fit a black 2 × 6 brick against each end of the central bricks, leaving two base columns exposed at each end.

steps.title: Tile the center of the crossbar
steps.description: Bridge both brick seams with white 2 × 6 tiles, flush with the central tile. Leave two black stud columns at each end.

steps.title: Build the flower supports
steps.description: Fit a lime flower on the front stud of each rounded plate, then mount each pair on the inner exposed base column.

motion.source: Page 42, step 77, two repeated plate-and-flower insets

steps.title: Fit the green end pads
steps.description: Build each green pad with its red round pin tile on the rear stud. Mount the front stud of the studded edge over the outer rear base stud. The pad overhangs outward and to the rear, leaving the front base stud exposed.

motion.source: Page 42, step 78, two repeated green-pad and red-pin insets

steps.title: Slide in the blue end connectors
steps.description: Slide each blue stepped plate beneath the green pad’s outer overhang. Its lower rear stud supports the pad; the raised row extends beyond the base.

steps.title: Bridge the end pads
steps.description: Fit a black 1 × 4 plate along each rear row, spanning the rounded support, green pad and raised blue row. Add a lime flower on each raised front stud.

steps.title: Cap the end frames
steps.description: Fit two white corner plates around each recess. Their rear studs sit on the black strip and their front ends sit on the lime flowers.

steps.title: Build and fit the yellow pin blocks
steps.description: Insert the axle end of each blue pin into its yellow axle-hole brick. Fit the two bricks into the front recesses, spanning the exposed base stud and the blue lower stud.

motion.source: Page 44, step 82, two repeated axle-pin insets

steps.title: Add the sloping white caps
steps.description: Fit each white 4 × 2 slope with its high stud row toward the end and its toe meeting the tiled center. The underside bridges the black brick, white corners and yellow brick.

steps.title: Turn over and add the red end bricks
steps.description: Turn the crossbar over, then attach the red side-stud bricks beneath the outer rows of the blue connectors. Their side studs face outward.

steps.title: Build the underside brackets
steps.description: Stack two rounded plates, add the black bracket, then fit the gray hole brick and its rounded cap. Mount each completed inset beneath the base and blue lower row, with the rear cap supporting the green pad.

motion.source: Page 46, step 85, repeated numbered panels 1–3 and underside mounting arrows

steps.title: Add the inner underside spacers
steps.description: Fit a white log brick beneath the base beside each black bracket, with its two studs across the base rows.

steps.title: Start the first rear foot
steps.description: Fit a black 1 × 6 brick along the rear row of the black 4 × 6 base plate.

steps.title: Raise the rear edge
steps.description: Cap the rear brick with a black 1 × 6 plate. Fit a dark gray round brick in front of the leftmost rear stud.

steps.title: Build the foot connector block
steps.description: Stack the two white plates, fit the two blue stepped plates with side studs facing forward, then cap the inner three lower studs with the tan plate. Mount the block on the left four front columns.

motion.source: Page 47, step 89, numbered panels 1–2 and mounting arrow

steps.title: Bridge the foot supports
steps.description: Fit the white 3 × 3 corner plate between the rear wall and the tan plate, leaving the round brick accessible inside the corner.

steps.title: Add the upper foot supports
steps.description: Cap the left three forward blue studs with a tan plate. Fit the medium-nougat Technic brick over the round brick and exposed lower blue stud; its side plate extends inward over the tan support.

steps.title: Level the outer edge
steps.description: Add lime flowers on the outer white and tan studs, bringing both ends level with the Technic brick’s upper studs.

steps.title: Cover the foot with long slopes
steps.description: Tile the outer edge, then fit four black 6 × 1 slopes. Their high undersides rest on the white and tan supports; their lower undersides rest on the rear rail and blue connector.

steps.title: Build and attach the rubber-grip axle
steps.description: Follow panels 1–6: first axle brick, black axle, two rubber joiners, red axle, second brick, lower hinge plate and two upper rail plates. Mount the completed group beneath the slope toes.

motion.source: Page 48, step 94, numbered panels 1–6 and mounting arrow

steps.title: Mount the first rear foot
steps.description: Turn the foot to match the crossbar’s underside view. Slide its medium-nougat Technic hole over the blue pin; its blue side studs face outward and its base underside aligns with the red and white brick bottoms.

steps.title: Start the opposite rear foot
steps.description: Fit a black 1 × 6 brick along the rear row of the black 4 × 6 base plate.

steps.title: Raise the rear edge
steps.description: Cap the rear brick with a black 1 × 6 plate. Fit a dark gray round brick in front of the rightmost rear stud.

steps.title: Build the foot connector block
steps.description: Stack the two white plates, fit the two blue stepped plates with side studs facing forward, then cap the inner three lower studs with the tan plate. Mount the block on the right four front columns.

motion.source: Page 50, step 98, opposite-foot numbered inset and mounting arrow

steps.title: Bridge the foot supports
steps.description: Fit the white 3 × 3 corner plate between the rear wall and the tan plate, leaving the round brick accessible inside the corner.

steps.title: Add the upper foot supports
steps.description: Cap the right three forward blue studs with a tan plate. Fit the medium-nougat Technic brick over the round brick and exposed lower blue stud; its side plate extends inward over the tan support.

steps.title: Level the outer edge
steps.description: Add lime flowers on the outer white and tan studs, bringing both ends level with the Technic brick’s upper studs.

steps.title: Cover the foot with long slopes
steps.description: Tile the outer edge, then fit four black 6 × 1 slopes. Their high undersides rest on the white and tan supports; their lower undersides rest on the rear rail and blue connector.

steps.title: Build and attach the rubber-grip axle
steps.description: Follow panels 1–6: first axle brick, black axle, two rubber joiners, red axle, second brick, lower hinge plate and two upper rail plates. Mount the completed group beneath the slope toes.

motion.source: Page 51, step 103, opposite-foot numbered inset and mounting arrow

steps.title: Mount the opposite rear foot
steps.description: Slide the opposite foot onto the remaining blue pin. Its blue connector studs face the outer side, matching the first foot’s handedness across the crossbar.

steps.title: Lock the feet to the crossbar
steps.description: Fit two black corner plates beneath each foot joint. Their front arms attach under the foot base and their rear tips attach under the rounded bracket stack.

steps.title: Bridge the stepped underside supports
steps.description: Fit a curved inverted slope and a black stepped connector beneath each crossbar end. Their upper stud rows meet the red and white brick bottoms; their lower rows meet the bracket and corner-plate bottoms.

steps.title: Reinforce the foot undersides
steps.description: Fit a white 2 × 6 plate along the center of each foot underside, joining the base to the gray hinge plate at the toe.

steps.title: Add the outer foot connectors
steps.description: Fit three black stepped plates along each outer underside edge. Their upper rows attach beneath the black base and gray hinge; their lower rows attach beneath the white reinforcement.

steps.title: Cover the first outer foot face
steps.description: Attach the black 2 × 8 plate across the upper side connectors, leaving the rearmost connector column exposed. Add the left 2 × 6 wedge below it, with its full stud row beside the rectangular plate.

steps.title: Tie the first side cover together
steps.description: Fit a black 2 × 2 tile across the seam between the rectangular side plate and the first two studs of the wedge.

steps.title: Cover the opposite outer foot face
steps.description: Turn the view to the other side. Fit the black 2 × 8 plate and the mirrored right wedge, preserving the exposed rear connector column.

steps.title: Tie the opposite side cover together
steps.description: Fit the second black 2 × 2 tile across the seam between the rectangular plate and wedge.

steps.title: Join the rear crossbar to the frame
steps.description: Turn the completed rear assembly upright and fit both pairs of rail brackets onto the exposed white corner and yellow brick studs.

steps.title: Lock the rear corners
steps.description: Fit the two black joining plates along the outer rail faces, bridging each rail to the rear assembly.

steps.title: Complete the blue edge
steps.description: Continue each blue edge with two long tiles, covering the rear joining plates and tying them into the foot side covers.

steps.title: Start the front mechanism
steps.description: Fit the black log brick on the left two studs of the rear edge of the dark gray open-center plate.

steps.title: Extend the rear wall
steps.description: Attach the lime flower beneath the outer end of the black 1 × 3 brick, then mount the brick on the two remaining rear studs. The flower hangs beyond the plate edge.

motion.source: Page 62, step 117, flower insertion arrow and completed-group mounting arrow

steps.title: Add the orange axle blocks
steps.description: Fit an orange axle-hole brick on each side of the opening, directly in front of the rear wall. Their holes run across the assembly.

steps.title: Fit the white pin block
steps.description: Insert the black friction pin into the outward face of the white hole brick, then mount the pair immediately in front of the left orange axle block.

motion.source: Page 63, step 119, pin insertion and mounting arrows

steps.title: Build the white corner support
steps.description: Fit the cutout inverted slope beneath the outer stud of the white faceted brick, then seat the inner stud in front of the right orange axle block.

motion.source: Page 63, step 120, underside insertion then mounting

steps.title: Build the blue upright
steps.description: Stack two lime flowers on the blue bracket, then fit the completed stack to the front-right base stud with its side studs facing forward.

motion.source: Page 63, step 121, stacked flowers and bracket mounting

steps.title: Cap the mechanism walls
steps.description: Fit the black three-stud plate along the left wall, two blue corner plates along the rear edge, and the rounded dark gray plate over the white brick and flower stack.

steps.title: Build the long right wall
steps.description: Stack the offset plates, add the six-stud brick and end brick, then fit the yellow clip at the rear. Mount the wall across the blue rear corner, white brick and raised white ring.

motion.source: Page 64, step 123, numbered panels 1–3 and final mounting arrow

steps.title: Raise the inner right wall
steps.description: Fit the black three-stud brick across the blue corner and the rounded cap above the bracket.

steps.title: Bridge the upper wall with the blue connector
steps.description: Fit the stepped blue plate across both walls, with its raised row and side studs facing outward.

steps.title: Build the rear clip post
steps.description: Fit the lime flower on the tan round brick, then mount the stack on the yellow clip.

motion.source: Page 65, step 126, flower and round-brick inset

steps.title: Raise both rows of the blue connector
steps.description: Fit the tan side-stud brick to the raised row. Stack the two rounded plates on the inner row.

motion.source: Page 65, step 127, stacked rounded-plate inset

steps.title: Extend the upper front corner
steps.description: Fit the light gray corner brick around the inner recess and the tall black side-stud brick on the two frontmost wall studs.

steps.title: Add the open window frames
steps.description: Fit the white four-stud window across the rear wall, the dark gray narrow window over the left side, and a rounded cap across the rear tan post and tan brick.

steps.title: Build the hanging Technic link
steps.description: Insert the friction pin into the rear hole of the yellow brick, slide the lime five-hole beam onto it, then fit the completed link above the inner rounded stack.

motion.source: Page 66, step 130, numbered pin and beam insertion panels

steps.title: Level the front upper supports
steps.description: Fit the tan round brick on the inner gray corner, the black two-stud brick along its outer arm, and the black square plate on the rear stud of the tall black block.

steps.title: Build the upper pin and hole blocks
steps.description: Build the gray pin brick on its rounded plate. Build the white square plate with the rear black brick and two white hole bricks, then fit both completed groups across the upper supports.

motion.source: Page 67, step 132, two insets and numbered white-block panels

steps.title: Fit the outer upright and corner ledge
steps.description: Fit the tall black side-stud brick on the exposed tan stud. Bridge the front support levels with the black three-by-three corner plate, leaving its inner tip overhanging.

steps.title: Finish the upper front wall
steps.description: Fit the three-stud black brick on the corner ledge and the tall side-stud brick at the front end, with its two side studs facing forward.

steps.title: Start the separate front rail
steps.description: Fit the black two-by-three plate across the right end of the gray ten-stud base, leaving one row overhanging the rear.

steps.title: Add the rounded rail support
steps.description: Fit the dark gray rounded plate beside the black end plate, across both base rows.

steps.title: Build the rail end stop
steps.description: Fit the three-stud black brick across the rounded support and end plate. Add the log brick behind it and the low black slope on the front row.

steps.title: Extend the rail and add its first inverted slope
steps.description: Overlap the second gray ten-stud plate with the left half of the base. Fit the inverted slope beside its right edge, projecting toward the front.

steps.title: Extend and reinforce the left end
steps.description: Fit the third gray ten-stud plate underneath the left half of the upper plate. Add the white two-by-four plate on the exposed left section, leaving the end column clear.

steps.title: Build the central rail wall
steps.description: Fit the six- and three-stud black bricks along the rear row. Add the lime flower, black four-stud plate and dark gray tile along the front row, and cap the high row of the inverted slope with the two-stud pad.

steps.title: Build the left slope support
steps.description: Bridge the white and gray plates with the second inverted slope. Fit the black three-stud strip on the remaining white rear row and the rounded gray plate on its two inner front studs.

steps.title: Cap the full rear rail
steps.description: Bridge the rear wall and both slope supports with the long black plate and short joining plate. Cover the two-by-two end stop with the square plate.

steps.title: Build the blue rail connectors
steps.description: Stack the two tan plates, fit the two blue stepped plates beneath them, then mount the completed group on the four front-row studs. The side studs face forward.

motion.source: Page 70, step 143, numbered tan-stack and blue-connector inset

steps.title: Raise the long upper rail wall
steps.description: Fit the three-, two- and six-stud bricks along the right eleven cap studs. Bridge the left two tan studs and rear cap with the dark gray two-stud pad.

steps.title: Finish the left cap and front slope
steps.description: Stack the two black plates over the pad’s rear studs. Fit the black slope on the remaining two tan studs.

motion.source: Page 71, step 145, two stacked black plates

steps.title: Finish the rear end of the rail
steps.description: Fit the black log brick on the two remaining rear studs of the square end cap.

steps.title: Mount the completed rail
steps.description: Seat the overhanging rear row of the completed rail on the two left front studs of the mechanism base. Keep the rail as a rigid completed assembly.

steps.title: Build and mount the upper blue-pin block
steps.description: Build the corner base, rounded plate and tile, add the two white hole bricks, thread the long blue pin through both, and add the flower. Mount the completed group on the rail end.

motion.source: Page 72, step 148, numbered panels 1–4 and mounting arrow

steps.title: Join the upper and lower pins with the bent beam
steps.description: Turn the view around and slide the gray bent beam onto the upper blue pin and the lower black pin together. Its five-hole arm stands vertically; the lower three-hole arm points toward the rear.

steps.title: Raise the middle of the mounted rail
steps.description: Return to the front view and fit the six- and three-stud black bricks along the middle nine upper rail studs.

steps.title: Bridge the mechanism with the colored brackets
steps.description: Fit the orange bracket across the lime flower and inner black ledge stud. Add the reddish brown bracket on the adjacent ledge stud, with all six side studs facing forward.

steps.title: Cap the colored brackets and cover the lower stud
steps.description: Bridge the three upper studs with the black plate. Build the small plate-and-tile cover and fit it to the lower-left orange side stud.
